gsl.statement: GSL-4 (candidate; BL-071, the interval-6 characterization): the tritone's role in the boundary geography is measure-dependent. (a) Displacement six is a ti-pole-local concentration - 12 of the 36 D7 contact-domain instances sit at single-pitch tritone displacement (1/3 against the 630/6930 structural baseline; the fa-pole domain carries none, 0/28), the two recorded instances being exactly the terminal far contacts 127:253 and 4033:2017, while the fully excluded class is displacement four (0 of 12 recorded). (b) Rotation six is the boundary cycles' closure interval - both seven-cycles (the D7 modal orbit and the A0 P7 ring) close at rotation six, and all seven D-tier anchor families carry at least one rotation-six pair (12/1176 against the ledger's 126/106491). (c) IC6 content shows no boundary over-representation (the boundary is IC6-poor). The three measures disagree, and the disagreement is the characterization.

role: the interval-6 characterization: the tritone as the boundary layer's candidate geometric signature, measured across five universes and three distinct measures, with pre-registered baselines; planning evidence

M-DISP.assessment: ti-local concentration, not boundary-wide and not exclusion: 12 of 36 D7-domain instances sit at single-pitch tritone displacement (1/3 versus the 630/6930 structural baseline; TEST-2 against the fa-pole: 12/36 versus 0/28); the two recorded instances are exactly the terminal far contacts 127:253 and 4033:2017; the fully excluded displacement class is 4 (0 of 12 recorded), and the recorded contact set is |d| <= 1 plus the two tritone terminals

M-IC6.assessment: no over-representation: the boundary's member states are IC6-poor (28 of 70 states at IC6 >= 2 versus 322 of 392 non-boundary states); the tritone-content measure does not mark the boundary

M-ROT.assessment: anchor-cycle scale: both boundary seven-cycles close at rotation 6 (the D7 modal orbit 4033->127 and the A0 P7 ring 2773->1387); every one of the seven D-tier anchor families carries at least one rotation-6 pair (12/1176 versus the 126/106491 ledger pair space); rotation-6 appears in no contact-domain relation (D7-36 0/36, D6 tier 0/98, A1 0/28)

roleVerdict.statement: the tritone's role is measure-dependent (the disagreement of the three measures is itself the finding, per the approved planning pass): displacement-six is a ti-pole-local separation concentration (with the terminal far contacts as its recorded instances), rotation-six is the boundary cycles' closure/transition interval at the anchor scale, and IC6 content shows no boundary signature at all. No single role fits all three measures; the honest verdict is mixed, decomposed above. No mechanism claim (V-BL-071-4): why the tritone plays these roles stays open (BL-072's question family).
